title: Lamb Stew with Russian Twist
description: A hearty lamb stew with a touch of Russian flair, featuring tender lamb and a rich, flavorful broth.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the lamb on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove from pot and set aside.
Add more oil if necessary, then sauté the onions until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the carrots and cook for another 5 minutes, or until they start to soften.
Add the stew, salt, and pepper to the pot. Stir to combine.
Return the lamb to the pot and bring to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer to the oven. Braise for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped parsley and cubed bread on the side.
Serve with crusty bread or over egg noodles, if desired.
